text: I can name the three DDoS families and design the layer that absorbs each, with amplification arithmetic.
I can show with numbers why per-IP rate limits miss a distributed L7 flood and what to do instead.
I can explain why parameterised queries prevent SQL injection and how to handle identifiers that can't be bound.
I can design a URL-fetching feature that resists SSRF, including IMDSv2, IP validation after resolution and an egress proxy.
I can list the 2021 OWASP Top 10 categories and a design-level defence for each.
